articles.title: Verify SMN backups
articles.searchText: verify smn backups prerequisites access to backup features requires the appropriate account permissions steps open settings maintenance open the backup tab when it is available to your account review the archive inventory statuses and verification results if authorized start a backup from the business interface and verify its outcome manually mark backup done once your procedure has been checked restore safeguards an available or verified backup does not mean restoration is authorized follow smn s displayed security checks do not replace the user interface with manual commands help checklist progress is local to the browser and is not included in backup archives

articles.title: Prepare the team calendar
articles.searchText: prepare the team calendar prerequisites a team must exist editing requires the appropriate privileges steps open the team calendar and select your team context review displayed days cycle periods absences and available calendar data if your role allows it review individual calendars and assignments under team members if the installation includes a scrum team an administrator can review working day settings from settings this screen is not intended for kanban only installations check results after making changes in the business screens then manually mark calendar done note absences public holidays and availability can differ between team members viewing a calendar does not automatically verify capacity

articles.title: FAQ and troubleshooting
articles.searchText: faq and troubleshooting a screen or action is missing some operations require administrator permissions a specific team or a scrum kanban mode review your account and active team do not bypass access checks with direct urls see the first setup guide in the help center or ask an administrator why does ticket csv import fail under tickets the csv must include id type resume priority status sp former jira column names are not supported check the date csv syntax and ticket identifiers as well refer to the tickets article in help why do i need to confirm replacement another snapshot already exists for the selected date smn asks for explicit confirmation before replacement recheck the file and date concurrent changes may require confirmation again why is ticket comparison unavailable at least two compatible snapshots are needed in the selected context why are sprints unavailable check that the installation team uses scrum and that you have permission to access it kanban teams use their own periods why is an indicator value missing review team and cycle context manually entered values formulas and source data a missing value is not automatically zero indicator settings can be restricted to administrators why can t a backup be restored if your account has the necessary permissions you can review archive inventory and restoration checks under settings maintenance an existing archive does not automatically authorize restoration mandatory safeguards must pass why did my help checkmarks disappear on another computer checklist progress is stored locally in the browser it is not synchronized or included in smn backups a new browser profile or origin starts without previous checkmarks what if help search fails try searching again from the help center when an index is unavailable accessible articles can still be opened from their categories the bundled documentation does not require an external service

articles.title: General settings: language, appearance and calendar reference
articles.searchText: general settings language appearance and calendar reference access and prerequisites open general settings using an authorized administrator account settings are saved by this business form not by the help center understand the three tabs general view the read only agile mode and product select a reference country from the list when needed language choose french or english from the currently available languages appearance choose the light or dark theme and an offered palette ocean forest violet or red purple agile mode and product are fixed information in this form they cannot be edited here change and save settings 1 open the tab for the setting you want to change 2 choose the desired value from its selector for the reference country you can leave the selection empty when offered 3 an alert indicates unsaved changes select save the button is disabled when nothing changed or while saving 4 read the confirmation or error message display settings such as language theme or palette may refresh the interface after saving 5 if needed use reload to restore the currently saved values check the revision or update date displayed by the form errors and precautions revision conflict settings changed since the form loaded reload and review the latest values before trying again invalid value choose an allowed option and retry load or network error use the retry action and check the local connection to smn pending edits save or discard your changes before leaving smn warns about unsaved drafts access denied a user without administrative rights must not attempt to change settings final check confirm the intended values are saved and displayed the help center checklist does not validate settings automatically mark general done only after your own review

articles.title: Dynamic indicators
articles.searchText: dynamic indicators prerequisites you must be signed in and have access to at least one team editing the catalog and permissions depends on your account role view indicators open indicators select an authorized team and review its scrum or kanban indicators check cycle values and the available displays in the relevant screens indicators may use manual values or formulas a missing value is not necessarily zero administration an administrator can review indicator settings from settings including definitions and permissions before changing a formula inspect its dependencies and potential effects on dashboards and reports if an action is unavailable review your role and selected team rather than bypassing access checks common issues no indicator or value review team cycle context permissions and the underlying data needed for calculation unexpected result check the formula and dependencies before treating it as a defect access denied ask an administrator to review your permissions the help center never edits indicators or formulas

articles.title: Jira settings
articles.searchText: jira settings prerequisites jira configuration is restricted to administrators accessing the page does not guarantee that your environment can reach an external jira service steps open jira settings review the fields and current values presented by the form enter only the necessary configuration details and follow the available verification feedback save through the business form and check the result before considering the integration configured security never include tokens passwords or other private details in help articles or public screenshots non administrative accounts must not be directed to this restricted settings page

articles.title: Prepare Kanban periods
articles.searchText: prepare kanban periods prerequisites you need access to a kanban team managing periods requires the appropriate permissions steps open kanban periods review existing periods and the selected team context if authorized use the period creation form verify displayed details and dates after saving manually mark cadence done once the periods are ready scrum and kanban a kanban period is not a scrum sprint help does not create any period

articles.title: Members: view profiles and manage assignments
articles.searchText: members view profiles and manage assignments prerequisites and permissions a team must exist open team members with an authorized account this detailed configuration guide is intended for administrators adding editing and managing assignments require the appropriate permissions find team members 1 choose the appropriate team or context if multiple teams are available 2 select cards or list in the header 3 use the search role function and status filters apply them with filter or reset to restore the full list 4 review the active and inactive member groups separately then open the required member record 5 check the name function location roles and displayed assignment information visible details depend on recorded data the cards list preference is saved locally in the browser it does not change business assignments add a member if the add action is available in the header 1 open add member 2 enter the required name if the company selector is offered choose the correct company 3 confirm creation and verify the member appears in the team 4 open the member profile to complete details and check assignments the action may be unavailable because your role does not allow creation or the current team does not satisfy the form s conditions adding a member does not prove that they are assigned for the entire sprint review profiles and assignments on a member profile check the professional function city and country when provided verify assignment start and end dates and associated roles scrum master product owner and developer an ended or inactive assignment is not the same as a deleted profile review active and inactive sections when checking history compare absences and working days in the member calendar before interpreting sprint capacity after an authorized change revisit the profile or list to confirm the saved result troubleshooting member missing from the list check the team filters status and chosen presentation cannot add or edit verify the account role and context permissions do not bypass access checks dates or capacity look incorrect compare assignments and calendar working days before assuming a calculation error final check help does not create members or assignments manually mark members done in the help center only after checking profiles and assignment dates

articles.title: First-time configuration of SMN
articles.searchText: first time configuration of smn this guide covers your first steps with scrum master notebook after installation reading a help article does not change any business data before signing in install smn from the windows distribution and launch it using the supplied launcher open the local address displayed by the launcher follow the installation s initial setup and first administrator account screens when needed this happens before the help center is available sign in business configuration requires the appropriate account permissions first configuration after sign in general if you are an administrator review general settings from the settings menu team if you are an administrator create a team from settings teams calendar check the team calendar and applicable working days members if your account has the required access review member profiles and assignments under team members cadence prepare sprints for scrum or kanban periods for kanban using the section that matches your team s agile mode tickets review tickets after selecting a team and cycle reports open reports when the required data is available backup if your account has backup permissions open the backups tab under settings maintenance the direct links above lead to screens authorized accounts can read administrative operations are described without misleading links use smn navigation only when your account has the required rights the help center checklist filters applicable steps by your role and agile mode track your progress you manually choose to do in progress or done self declared for each applicable step reading help never marks a step as done the counter shows your declarations not automatic validation by smn progress is stored only in the browser profile for this smn origin it is not transferred to another computer or included in smn backups backup and restore a backup archive alone does not authorize restoration if your account can access settings maintenance review verification results and security prerequisites before restoring

articles.title: Registers: risks, impediments, dependencies, decisions, actions and highlights
articles.searchText: registers risks impediments dependencies decisions actions and highlights access registers open registers after selecting a team your account can access the data shown depends on the team and when offered the selected cycle the main list distinguishes risks impediments and dependencies smn also supports decisions actions and highlights including in related record details and journals do not expect six separate tabs on the main list browse and find an entry on the list choose an available category or use the search and filters provided status cycle sorting and other criteria visible according to your permissions open a record to review its title date status description and where available type specific details relationships and journal check the team and cycle before comparing information the list can be empty even when records exist in another context users without management permission can view entries in read only mode editing and deletion actions are not shown to them understand the six types risk a risk describes something that might happen its statuses are open and resolved you can also provide a probability an impact and a roam response during creation these assessments are separate from the risk s status impediment an impediment describes a difficulty that has occurred its possible statuses are open in progress resolved and abandoned review the status changes and the details recorded in its entry dependency a dependency describes coordination between a requester and a contributor each associated with the local team or an external party it can also be marked at risk its statuses are open in progress satisfied and cancelled if you enter the parties in the form the requester and contributor must be specified consistently an external party requires a name decision a decision records a choice and where provided its rationale it can reference a previous decision that it replaces the statuses are active replaced and cancelled decisions can also be found through related record journals or relationships follow the creation context instead of expecting them among the main category tabs action an action represents work or follow up to perform its statuses are to do in progress completed and cancelled depending on your permissions its record may display links to other items and a tracking history highlight a highlight records a notable event or piece of information it uses the recorded status it may be created or found through a related journal depending on the actions provided by that record it does not create a new main list tab create edit or delete if your account offers the create action open the creation dialog and select a type available in that context the form asks for a title date and status then shows additional fields for the chosen type available types may be restricted when creation starts from a journal use the displayed options rather than trying to force an unavailable type with appropriate permissions open a record and use the available edit actions permanent deletion is separate from reading a record it requires management permission and can be refused when linked data a conflict or a protection prevents the operation review the record and consequences before confirming reading this article does not create update or delete any entry common issues no entries check the team cycle category and filters before assuming information is missing action not shown your role or the creation context may restrict available actions and types form rejected verify the title required fields and for dependencies the requester and contributor deletion rejected review the record s message and linked items do not bypass a protective refusal

articles.title: Reports: view, create and generate documents
articles.searchText: reports view create and generate documents access and scope open reports after signing in and select an authorized team when the screen provides that option results depend on the team sprint or cycle and your account permissions creating a new report from the header is restricted to administrators when the screen allows it understand the four tabs reports browse saved documents use search sprint or cycle filters and any available status filter then open a report with the read action templates browse available office templates the catalog detects word and powerpoint templates in smn s configured folders tags read the available office expressions the tag configurator helps you build and copy a tag for a simple value indicator row or chart archives browse archived items within your authorized context available filters include searching and cycle selection the four tabs are separate workflows not mandatory steps read an existing report 1 on reports choose the relevant cycle or leave all to browse the current scope 2 enter a search phrase if needed apply filters and review the results 3 check the title sprint or cycle model status and update date 4 open the document using its read action if nothing appears check the team and filters first create a report in smn if you are an administrator and new report is available 1 open the creation dialog from the report center header 2 choose an available sprint or cycle and template 3 enter the title and choose french or english 4 select create the action may be disabled when no suitable cycle or template exists or a required field is missing 5 find the new report in the list and review its content creating it does not guarantee that all model data is available generate an office document from a template on templates after selecting a word or powerpoint model 1 select the cycle offered by the form and enter a filename 2 choose the document language and when available a chart style 3 if the template uses ticket data select the ticket snapshots required by the form 4 choose generate to download a file or save to place it in smn s reports folder these are separate actions 5 if saving detects an existing file review the overwrite confirmation before proceeding inspect the generated document afterward generation may fail when a model or data source is unavailable a tag is invalid or the ticket selection is unsuitable fix the fields or template before trying again do not treat missing data as zero build template tags on tags open the configurator and choose a family and its available options copy the generated expression into your office template table tags may support sorting chart tags offer compatible chart types and styles for the selected indicators check team data availability before using indicator tags result and limitations generating and saving reports are business operations separate from reading help help center progress is self declared mark reports done only after checking your own output opening this guide never generates a document

articles.title: Prepare your first Scrum sprint
articles.searchText: prepare your first scrum sprint prerequisites you need access to a scrum team creation operations require appropriate privileges this guide does not apply to kanban steps open sprints select the relevant scrum team review existing sprints or use the generation action if you are an administrator check cadence dates and statuses before confirming a business operation verify the sprint in the list afterwards and manually mark cadence done note smn may redirect to the home page when scrum mode or permissions are unavailable the help center does not generate sprints

articles.title: Create a team
articles.searchText: create a team prerequisites an authorized administrator should first review general settings steps open settings teams use the create team button in the page header complete the fields shown in the form including the name and agile mode when offered save then verify that the team appears in the list return to the checklist and declare team done when the team actually exists scrum or kanban the team s mode controls which screens and features apply sprints belong to scrum kanban periods belong to kanban help never creates a team on your behalf

articles.title: Tickets: view and import CSV snapshots
articles.searchText: tickets view and import csv snapshots open the module open tickets after selecting a team and cycle in smn the tabs let you view imported files browse their tickets and compare snapshots when multiple files exist import replacement and deletion require appropriate permissions and may be unavailable for a closed cycle required csv format the first row must include these six technical column names not the former jira headers id type resume priority status sp id ticket identifier type ticket type resume ticket summary priority priority status status sp story points the columns may appear in a different order if each required name occurs exactly once the current validation contract accepts additional columns comma semicolon and tab delimiters are recognized files must use the csv extension and must not exceed 8 mib or 20 000 tickets import a snapshot on tickets choose an available cycle and select import csv when enabled choose the csv file and enter its business date expand the required header section in the dialog if needed run validation correct missing or duplicate headers missing or duplicate ticket ids and malformed csv content if a snapshot already exists for that date you must explicitly confirm replacement review the date and contents before proceeding after import verify the snapshot in the list and use browse or compare troubleshooting import disabled check the team cycle selection cycle status and account permissions csv rejected check extension date the six header names ticket identifiers and file limits replacement requested the chosen date already has a snapshot overwriting never happens silently compare unavailable you need at least two snapshots in the selected context reading this guide never imports a file
